title: Minecraft, but Chunks get Invisible
description: If you touch a chunk, it gets invisible. Good luck trying to speedrun.
body:
# Invisible Chunks

Invisible Chunks is a Fabric mod where **any new chunk a player enters becomes invisible**.

The feature is controlled by a gamerule:

```
/gamerule invisibleChunksMode true
```

- Default: `false`
- When enabled, newly touched chunks turn invisible
- Disabled by default
- Requires Fabric Loader >= 0.18.4
